required_value: Effective version and dispatch or forecast scope
public_first_choice: Resolve dated coefficients and recursively expand the applicable RHS
decision_or_limit: Keep defaults conditional on their documented trigger

required_value: Signed MW on the named electrical boundary
public_first_choice: Decode the matching issued monitor and verify its definition
if_only_regional_forecasts: Fit local/region shares by delivery clock or regress on regional demand and rooftop PV using historical electrical labels
decision_or_limit: Population is a cold-start scenario until local labels exist

public_first_choice: Reconcile regional demand and eligible scheduled loads against historical case inputs
if_only_regional_forecasts: Forecast eligible pumps separately or specify off and running schedules
decision_or_limit: Adding all dispatchable load can improve a score while misrepresenting the input

public_first_choice: Latest public metered flow or preceding target from the same forecast vintage
if_only_regional_forecasts: Use a signed clock/day-type baseline by link and scenario-test flow changes
decision_or_limit: Select separately by link and lead and preserve negative flow

required_value: Initial active MW for each named DUID
public_first_choice: Latest signed SCADA or previously issued plant path where accessible
if_only_regional_forecasts: Use plant share of issued regional cleared generation or anchor plus regional change
decision_or_limit: Preserve curtailment and distinguish MW dispatched from energy available

public_first_choice: Last observed unit state with public dated availability and outage schedule where available
if_only_regional_forecasts: Use unit clock/start/stop scenarios with ramp and capacity bounds
decision_or_limit: Regional supply does not determine unit commitment

required_value: Initial signed MW and energy available
public_first_choice: Latest unit MW and available state of charge with issue-time availability
if_only_regional_forecasts: Clock by unit plus idle/charge/discharge scenarios within power and energy limits
decision_or_limit: Price-only dispatch and always-idle settings failed on the active battery

required_value: Regional or local embedded PV MW
public_first_choice: Use issued AEMO regional rooftop PV mean
if_only_regional_forecasts: Fit a local PV response or use installed-PV shares as an untested scenario
decision_or_limit: Account for PV already included in net demand to avoid double counting

required_value: Applied rating at the correct terminal and duration
public_first_choice: Match the public standing rating and class to the equipment and confirm whether it is dynamic
if_only_regional_forecasts: Compare last rating and seasonal/clock rating and apply a weather scenario
decision_or_limit: Use a dated rating forecast only when its equipment mapping and issue time are verified

required_value: Signed MW or apparent MVA at the nominated terminal
public_first_choice: Earlier terminal measurements or electrically matched state estimate
if_only_regional_forecasts: Fit a local relationship to regional dispatch and flows with topology fixed
decision_or_limit: Keep MW and MVA distinct and test joint errors across terms

public_first_choice: Earlier point or published monitor with the same definition
if_only_regional_forecasts: Use local clock/regime baselines and high/low reactive and voltage scenarios
decision_or_limit: Calibrate per device against held-out observations

required_value: The named aggregate and its native units
public_first_choice: Use the last published aggregate or sum eligible committed units with documented constants
if_only_regional_forecasts: Scenario-test likely unit combinations and synchronous condensers
decision_or_limit: Historical constancy provides no validation on transitions

required_value: Exact binary status or timer branch
public_first_choice: Apply known switch logic with the latest public state and announced changes
if_only_regional_forecasts: Run discrete topology and timer scenarios
decision_or_limit: Keep attainable RHS branches and their possible durations

public_first_choice: Use dated public entered forecast or a verified matching monitor
if_only_regional_forecasts: Carry last valid entry within its effective window and stress plausible alternatives
decision_or_limit: Plant output alone cannot identify an entered setting

required_value: Separate M and N availability and W switch
public_first_choice: Use previously public directional offers and an issued flow direction as a switch proxy
if_only_regional_forecasts: Model outages and operating direction as joint scenarios
decision_or_limit: Contemporaneous individual offers are recipient-private until next-day release and zero flow can coexist with full offers

required_value: Precisely named prior value at its required interval
public_first_choice: Seed from earlier public result and recursively roll a consistent forecast path
if_only_regional_forecasts: Carry or clock benchmark and stress the first forecast step
decision_or_limit: Track lags and avoid realised values inside the forecast horizon

required_value: Active sets plus LHS dispatch and marginal value
public_first_choice: Use issue-time set or outage information and matched public constraint solution
if_only_regional_forecasts: Run active and inactive scenarios plus a joint LHS/RHS range
decision_or_limit: Publish ambiguity near the boundary and validate alerts on event days
